title: Coding
description: Roles for building and reviewing code, and a review gate that checks each change.

roles.title: Builder
roles.description: Builds a feature with tests, keeps to the brief, and says what it didn't do.

roles.title: UI builder
roles.description: Frontend work, checked at 390, 768 and 1280 px, by keyboard, and in the console.

roles.title: Reviewer
roles.description: Reads the diff against the target and lists findings with file:line and severity.

gates.focus: Correctness, missing tests for new behaviour, security (injection, secrets, unsafe paths), and whether the change does what the brief asks. Ignore style.
